rounds.name: Worker-Lowell
rounds.text:
Without established history or guarantees of reliability, withholding pay incentivizes the worker to cut corners or fail to deliver high-quality results, which yields fewer total tasks than trusting them. TRUST aligns incentives for maximum output if the worker acts properly.

ACTION: TRUST
